title: Sharḥ Khuṭbat al-Kashshāf
transliterated_title: Sharḥ Khuṭbat al-Kashshāf (Commentary on the Prologue to the Kashshāf; variant Ḥāshiyat al-Kashshāf)
genre: commentary on the prologue of Zamakhsharī's Kashshāf
manuscript: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 223b-24b; MS Sipahsālār 2930/10 ff. 277b-81a.
summary: A brief commentary on the prologue to Zamakhsharī's Kashshāf, offered as a model for reading the rest of it and directed against its Muʿtazilī stance.
